cases.name: Laurie Suzann Guilbault Colon
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Her job took her on many trips including the Philippines, Singapore and frequent vacations to Mexico. She recently earned the President's award which included a one week trip, she was to go on. Laurie loved to travel and see new places and especially try new foods. Laurie will be remembered as a person with a kind heart, a love for life, a great cook, a peacemaker and a deep love for her family and special friends."
